Core Functionality
At its heart, our RAG system excels in precise data handling and intelligent response generation.
Data Preprocessing
Read movies.txt, chunk into smaller 
pieces. Convert each chunk into a 
384-dimensional vector using gte-
small embedding model. Store 
vectors in Supabase for rapid retrieval.
Query Handling
User queries are transformed into 
vector embeddings. These are then 
compared with stored embeddings via 
cosine similarity for relevance.
